compose_transforms_on_text: apply a sequence of text augmentation transforms to a string or list of strings using Compose
compose_with_seed: apply Compose transforms to text with a fixed random seed for reproducible augmentation results
compose_with_metadata: apply Compose transforms to text and collect execution metadata including source and destination length
oneof_random_transform: apply OneOf to randomly select and apply one transform from a weighted list of text transforms
oneof_force_apply: force apply OneOf to text by setting force=True to bypass the probability check
